import argparse
import csv
import sys


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--out', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    with open(args.out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
        csv.writer(handle).writerow(['id', 'total'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])
